title: List page
description: A records page: title, toolbar (status pills, search, refresh, add), a data table that sorts, selects and pages, bulk actions. Copy it with `semi add list-page`.
when: Orders, customers, products, jobs: any page whose job is to find and act on records.

instead.need: Entities people recognise by image and status

a11y: Filters and search sit above the table they filter; the table has a caption; bulk actions appear as a labelled region.
